description_en: Tests the connectivity of an AI model provider and model under a specified AgentTeams instance by sending a test prompt and returning the call result, latency, and token usage
description_zh: 用于测试指定 AgentTeams 实例下 AI 模型供应商和模型的连通性，发送一条测试 Prompt 并返回调用结果、延迟和 Token 用量
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams test-model-provider --instance-id i-xxx --provider-id RUNNING --model-name AgentTeams --prompt Hello,_how_are_you0 --provider-name my-provider --region cn-hangzhou
name: TestModelProvider

parameters.help_en: The provider ID. Optional. Filters by exact match on instance status
parameters.help_zh: 可选，实例状态精确匹配
parameters.name: provider_id

parameters.help_en: The model name. Optional. Filters by fuzzy match on instance name
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按实例名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The content of the test prompt
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The name of the model provider
parameters.name: provider_name
